newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus parliament to seek Lukashenko impeachment.
newsitem.headline: Belarus parliament to seek Lukashenko impeachment.

text.p: A delegation of Belarus parliamentary deputies arrived at the constitutional court on Saturday saying they had come to continue impeachment proceedings against President Alexander Lukashenko.
"Parliament will not now withdraw impeachment proceedings because Lukashenko has annulled the agreement which was signed," Alexander Dobrovolsky told Reuters as he arrived at the court.
Parliament speaker Semyon Sharetsky told a news conference he had signed a fresh request to impeach the president.
"I have signed the request about impeachment and sent it to the constitutional court. I have also withdrawn yesterday's request (to halt impeachment proceedings)," he said.

Impeachment proceedings were halted after Friday's Russian-brokered deal between Lukashenko and parliament but the compromise collapsed on Saturday when deputies failed to approve it and Lukashenko said he was scrapping his side of the bargain.

Dobrovolsky said the deputies had collected more than the minimum 70 signatures necessary to restart the impeachment procedure. He accused Lukashenko of deliberately sabotaging the agreement with parliament.
